name: calculation
description: Type of calculation. 'scf'=self-consistent field; 'nscf'=non-self-consistent; 'bands'=band structure; 'relax'=ionic relaxation; 'md'=molecular dynamics; 'vc-relax'=variable-cell relaxation; 'vc-md'=variable-cell MD.

name: prefix
description: Prefix for output file names, used to name the .save directory and various output files.

name: outdir
description: Output directory (scratch directory) that holds the .save directory and temporary files.

name: pseudo_dir
description: Directory containing pseudopotential files.

name: tprnfor
description: Whether to compute and print atomic forces. Automatically enabled for relaxation or MD calculations.

name: tstress
description: Whether to compute and print the stress tensor. Automatically enabled for vc-relax or vc-md calculations.

name: forc_conv_thr
description: Convergence threshold for ionic relaxation in Ry/bohr. Convergence is reached when all forces fall below this value.

name: etot_conv_thr
description: Total energy convergence threshold for ionic relaxation (energy difference between consecutive steps) in Ry.

name: nstep
description: Maximum number of relaxation or MD steps.

name: restart_mode
description: Restart mode: 'from_scratch' starts a fresh calculation; 'restart' continues from a previous interrupted run.

name: verbosity
description: Output verbosity level: 'low'=minimal; 'medium'=moderate; 'high'=detailed; 'debug'=full debug output.

name: ibrav
description: Bravais lattice type index. 0=specify the lattice manually via the CELL_PARAMETERS card; other values select a standard lattice type (requires celldm or A/B/C/cosAB parameters to be set accordingly).

name: nat
description: Total number of atoms in the unit cell. Required. Must match the number of atom lines in ATOMIC_POSITIONS.

name: ntyp
description: Number of atom types. Required. Must match the number of species in ATOMIC_SPECIES.

name: ecutwfc
description: Kinetic energy cutoff for wavefunctions in Ry. Typical values: NC pseudopotentials 40-80 Ry; PAW/US pseudopotentials 25-60 Ry.

name: ecutrho
description: Kinetic energy cutoff for charge density in Ry. NC pseudopotentials default to 4*ecutwfc; PAW/US pseudopotentials typically need 8-12*ecutwfc.

name: occupations
description: Occupation treatment: 'fixed'=fixed occupations (insulators); 'smearing'=Fermi smearing (metals); 'tetrahedra'=tetrahedron method; 'from_input'=manually specified.

name: smearing
description: Smearing method (used when occupations='smearing'): 'gaussian'; 'methfessel-paxton' (recommended for metals); 'marzari-vanderbilt'; 'fermi-dirac'.

name: degauss
description: Smearing width in Ry. Typical values for metals: 0.01-0.05 Ry. Excessively large values degrade accuracy.

name: nspin
description: Spin polarization: 1=non-spin-polarized; 2=collinear spin polarization; 4=non-collinear spin-orbit coupling.

name: nbnd
description: Number of bands to compute. Defaults to ceil(nelec/2) plus a few empty bands. Typically needs to be increased for band structure calculations.

name: input_dft
description: Override the exchange-correlation functional embedded in the pseudopotential. Examples: 'pbe', 'pbesol', 'hse', 'b3lyp'.

name: conv_thr
description: SCF convergence threshold (total energy change) in Ry. Typical value: 1e-6 for single-point; use 1e-8 or tighter for relaxation calculations.

name: mixing_beta
description: Charge density mixing parameter (Pulay/Broyden). Use 0.7 for insulators; reduce to 0.3-0.5 for metals or magnetic systems to improve convergence.

name: mixing_mode
description: Mixing scheme: 'plain'=simple linear mixing; 'TF'=Thomas-Fermi preconditioning; 'local-TF'=local Thomas-Fermi preconditioning.

name: electron_maxstep
description: Maximum number of SCF iterations. If SCF does not converge within this many steps, QE reports an error (results may still be written but should be checked).

name: diagonalization
description: Diagonalization algorithm: 'david'=Davidson-David (default, most efficient in general); 'cg'=conjugate gradient; 'ppcg'=parallel PCG; 'paro'=parallel RO.

name: ion_dynamics
description: Ionic motion algorithm (for relax/md): 'bfgs' (recommended for relaxation); 'damp' (damped MD); 'verlet' (MD); 'langevin'; 'fire', etc.

name: upscale
description: Upscaling factor for the BFGS convergence threshold. In the final steps, the SCF threshold is tightened to conv_thr/upscale to ensure accurate forces.

name: cell_dynamics
description: Cell optimization algorithm (used for vc-relax): 'bfgs' (recommended); 'damp-pr'; 'damp-w'.

name: press
description: External pressure for vc-relax/vc-md calculations in kbar. Positive values correspond to compression.
